meta.name: Vesper
meta.author: Sunnyside
meta.essence: Two inks, one horizon, and the star that stayed.
meta.promise: Everything made with this looks printed at night, not rendered in it.
meta.family: One star, one line, one cut.
meta.oneSentence: Vesper is a two-ink print system for the evening: a cobalt sky and a cream ground, a four-point star resting on the horizon, and a mark that is drawn once and never redrawn by a theme.

theme.family: drawn — one subject, one cut line, one flat fill
theme.material: two inks on uncoated cream stock: cobalt and cream, a pale blue second impression
theme.edge: square. A printed plate has corners; nothing here is a rounded card except the pill.
theme.offset: the second impression sits 2.2px down and right, never more
theme.stroke: no strokes anywhere — the horizon is a filled bar, not a line
theme.tile: square with a 4-unit chip radius; the pill is reserved for navigation
theme.radius: 0 / 2 / 4 / 999 — the pill is the only curve
theme.ring: cobalt at 2px, 2px offset; cream in the night scope
theme.label: uppercase Archivo, 0.16em, always above the thing it names
theme.field-recipe: cobalt ground, cream stipple rays from a single point, a horizon, a moon
theme.mark-form: a four-point star whose lower point rests on the horizon bar

primitives.name: chalk
primitives.role: Unprinted stock. The page in daylight.

primitives.name: plate
primitives.role: A plate laid on the stock. Surfaces only.

primitives.name: stock
primitives.role: The cream ink itself. Fields, not text.

primitives.name: dusk
primitives.role: The pale blue second impression. Night-side metadata.

primitives.name: cobalt
primitives.role: The cobalt ink. The one accent — ≤10% of a viewport.

primitives.name: night
primitives.role: The sky at its deepest. The night scope’s ground.

primitives.name: lampblack
primitives.role: The silhouette. All text on light.

primitives.name: muted
primitives.role: The third voice. Captions and metadata.

light.name: surface-plate
light.role: A card, a table row, a form.

light.name: surface-wash
light.role: The quiet field. Behind a specimen.

light.name: surface-loud
light.role: The one loud field. Two per page, maximum.

light.name: surface-night
light.role: The night scope, when used as a band.

night.name: surface-plate
night.role: A plate on the night field.

night.name: surface-wash
night.role: The cobalt field, now the quiet one.

night.name: surface-loud
night.role: The loud field inverts: cream on blue.

night.name: surface-night
night.role: Unchanged — it is already the ground.

night.name: focus-ring
night.role: Cream ring — cobalt would vanish here.

type.name: display-1
type.use: One per page: the name, or the idea.

type.name: label
type.use: Uppercase. Always above what it names.

type.name: figure
type.use: Tabular, right-aligned, never on a rule.

motion.name: strike
motion.use: Anything the user caused. A press is a press.

motion.name: settle
motion.use: A plate arriving. Once per view.

motion.name: impress
motion.use: The field building itself. Once per page load.
